title: ptelea trifoliata subsp. pallida
intro: Ptelea trifoliata subsp. pallida, commonly known as a subspecies of the American Ailanthus or also known as the Pale Wingnut, is a plant species native to Eastern Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving coughs and sore throats, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Ptelea trifoliata subsp. pallida have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
